text.tspan: This has an interesting consequence once we consider multiple binding sites, which is typical
of real promoters. This means many transcription factors can cooperate in recruiting the
enzymes needed for transcription. Let's consider just one additional binding site. What promoter
architectures give us the fastest decision time? Because of this saturation effect we just saw
the answer depends on concentration: at high concentration, cooperative binding is beneficial
but at low concentration, when binding is diffusion-limited, the best promoters are not cooperative.
